messages:
Marta: Quick follow-up from today’s runtime all-hands 1. PMs want 3 tiny but concrete items for the public roadmap: canary timing, what telemetry Product will see, and a one-line customer-facing fallback blurb.

Evan: Canary window planned 2026-04-20 -> 2026-04-27 for a focused canary pool. Broader rollout depends on canary signals; tentative broader push mid-May.

Noor: Telemetry scope: per-kernel p50/p95/p99 histograms, seq-length buckets (256/512/1024/2048+), kv-cache hit/miss, per-node memory delta over 1m/5m/1h, and an estimated cost-per-token metric. We'll add a product-facing tile with aggregated + opt-in per-tenant views.

Leah: Customer blurb suggestion: "Kernel rollouts use staged canaries and automatic fallback to healthy variants; customers can pin kernels or opt out via Console/SDK flags." Short and reusable.

Mateo: Quick perf guidance to include in the PM one-pager: for interactive workloads on 80G use microbatch=8-16 to keep median low; for throughput use batch>=64. Note v4+ increases transient KV allocations on long sequences, so prefer quantized variants or smaller microbatches for seq>1024.

infra-bot: [alert] 2026-04-21T02:11 - Canary pool notice: transient memory surge detected on subset of 80G nodes; 6% traffic diverted to fallback variants.

Evan: Ops mitigations (short term): 1) drop canary default batch_size to 16 for affected pools, 2) divert heavy-tail sessions to v3 variants, 3) throttle KV prefetch. We'll script toggles for quick rollback.

Noor: Root-cause hypothesis: aggressive KV prealloc on long attention windows. Patch plan: reduce prealloc slab and short-circuit empty KV writes. Target patch ETA 36 hours; will retest in canary after patch.

Marta: PMs also asked for a single one-page mapping kernel -> expected latency tiers, cost-per-token, recommended batch sizes. Can we get a draft link by EOD PST?

Leah: I'll assemble the 1-pager with bench numbers (p50/p95/p99) and recommended defaults. Will include an appendix with example bench commands, e.g.: `./bench --model kernel-v4 --seq 512 --batch 16 --runs 50` and a CSV output sample.

Mateo: For on-call: add a routing-toggle snippet to the runbook so SREs can flip traffic without redeploy. Example POST: `POST /control/route/toggle {"from":"kernel-v4","to":"kernel-v3","pool":"canary"}`. I'll add the script.

Marta: Recap of actions: Noor = publish telemetry endpoints + patch ETA; Evan = scripts for quick toggles + ops playbook; Leah = PM 1-pager + perf appendix; Mateo = runbook toggle script. Please drop links here when ready.

Evan: Will post the toggles and playbook in #eng-oncall within 2 hours.

Noor: Patch build started; ETA 36h. Telemetry mock posted to Console staging.

Leah: Draft 1-pager uploaded to the shared drive: <link omitted>. Will refine after patch results.

Mateo: Runbook PR opened with toggle script.

Marta: Thanks everyone. PMs happy with this plan; will include the blurb and one-pager in the roadmap. :white_check_mark:
